lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Master!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Maaaaaster!
Yes?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I wanted to get Cocoa a gift.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Do you have any suggestions?
Is it her birthday?
Why do you want to get her a gift out of the blue?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: No, it's not her birthday.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: She's been working so hard recently,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: so Ade and I wanted to surprise her with a gift.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Ade wants me to come up with a few ideas,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: but I'm totally stumped.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I want to get Cocoa something that can come in handy.
How about some colored paper?
How about some sweet-and-sour ketchup?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I bought her some of that yesterday, hehe.
How about ketchup, then?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Ketchup?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: That's right! She was interested in this new brand of ketchup that just came out.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: That'd make for a great gift.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: She can use it to draw patterns on top of her omurice.
Are you sure that's enough to be considered a gift?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Absolutely! It's one of Cocoa's favorite things.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I can almost hear her now:

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Thank you so much! Ketchup is my absolute favorite!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Here, let me make you both some omurice.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Hahahaha

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'm gonna go buy some of that ketchup.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Thanks for the idea, Master!
